title: perch records (analysis/perch.jsonl)
description: Records of the analyzer's `perch` shadow plugin (analysis/perch.py): Google Perch 2.0 run beside BirdNET on 5 s windows, metadata only. `perch`: one record per window and source (`mixed` = the mean of the 8 beams, `loudest` = the beam with the highest RMS) holding the top-5 labels with their raw logits. `perch_agreement`: one record per UTC minute comparing Perch's best species with BirdNET's on the same windows. Windows the tagger flagged as speech, windows below the -70 dBFS gate and windows with a human-voice label in the top 5 produce no record at all. No audio is ever stored; embeddings only with --perch-embeddings and then in separate files, never in these records. Receivers MUST ignore unknown fields and skip a record whose `v` they do not know.

group.description: Group of a label: `bird`, `insect`, `amphibian`, `mammal`, `other-bio` (a binomial whose genus ui/taxa.json does not list), `non_species` (a non-species class of Perch's list such as `Alarm`, `Wind_chime`), `unknown` (no taxa table). The table lists only 19 insect genera, so `insect` undercounts: the non-species classes `Insect` and `Cricket` also map to it.

t.description: End of the 5 s window, PC wall-clock Unix seconds (as in every analysis record).

src.description: Which signal was classified: `mixed` = arithmetic mean of the 8 beams' waveforms, `loudest` = the single beam with the highest RMS of the window. Both go through 48 kHz -> 32 kHz polyphase resampling and the Perch peak normalisation (mean removed, peak 0.25). The two records of one window have the same `t`.

beam.description: 1-based beam of a `loudest` record; null for `mixed`.

level_dbfs.description: RMS level of the classified signal before normalisation, dB re full scale, one decimal. The loudest beam of every window is at or above the -70 dBFS gate.

top.description: The five largest logits, largest first, ties by lower label index, logit rounded to 3 decimals: [label, logit]. Labels are the entries of Perch's label list (iNaturalist-taxonomy binomials and FSD50k classes). The logits are RAW and uncalibrated: they are not probabilities and are not comparable between species or models. Human-voice labels never appear here.

best_species.description: [label, logit] of the highest-logit SPECIES label (a binomial) over the whole label list, whether or not it is in `top`; null only when the label list has no binomial.

mv.description: Model version: the model file's base name, `@`, the first 12 hex digits of its sha256.

run.description: The analyzer's run id (integer start time), as on novelty rows; null when unknown.

emb_i.description: Index of this record's embedding in perch_emb.jsonl / perch_emb.f16 (see the spec); null unless the analyzer ran with --perch-embeddings (or the write failed).

model.description: 1.1.0, optional. name Perch, version 2.0, variant = src, sha256 = of the model file (mv carries its first 12 digits).

claim.description: 1.1.0, optional. human_verified always false, source always model_opinion.

max_unstored_score.description: 1.1.0, optional. The 6th largest logit (best label not in `top`, which is the top_k).

t.description: Start of the UTC minute (a multiple of 60); a Perch window belongs to the minute its END falls in.

min_logit.description: The --perch-min-logit in force: Perch names a species when its best_species logit is at least this.

partial.description: Optional, present only when true: written at shutdown before the minute's grace period (15 s after its end) had passed, so late BirdNET windows may be missing.

windows.description: Perch windows (not records) of the minute that were written to perch.jsonl; windows = the sum of the seven category counts.

birds_missing.description: No BirdNET window overlapping the Perch window by at least 2 s that classified a beam: BirdNET has no opinion (gated, dropped, late, or the plugin is off). This is not silence.

perch_top1_groups.description: Windows per group of the top-1 label of the `loudest` source; the counts sum to `windows`.

insect.description: Windows whose Perch top-1 group is insect; windows whose BirdNET top species has group insect (windows with a BirdNET opinion only); windows where both hold.
